dialogue.origin: こんばんは。今日はよろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.content: Good evening. I look forward to working with you today.

dialogue.origin: こんばんは。よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.content: Good evening. Thank you.

dialogue.origin: 何かクライエント役への希望はありますか？
dialogue.content: Do you have any preferences for how you’d like me to play the client role?

dialogue.origin: 特に、希望はありませんのでよろしくお願いします。ご都合良いタイミングで始めさせていただきますので、おしらせください
dialogue.content: I don’t have any particular requests, thank you. Please let me know when you're ready to begin.

dialogue.origin: わかりました。
dialogue.content: Understood.

dialogue.origin: では、お願いします
dialogue.content: Okay, please begin.

dialogue.origin: はい、始めさせていただきます
dialogue.content: Alright, I'll begin now.

dialogue.origin: お願いします
dialogue.content: Please do.

dialogue.origin: こんにちは。相談員です。よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.content: Hello. I’m the counselor. Thank you for speaking with me.

dialogue.origin: よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: 本日はどのようなご相談ですか？
dialogue.content: What brings you here today?

dialogue.origin: はい、5月に父が亡くなったのですが、お葬式に行けなくて
dialogue.content: Well, my father passed away in May, but I wasn't able to attend his funeral.

dialogue.origin: 気持ちの整理がつかないのです…
dialogue.content: I'm having a hard time coming to terms with it...

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。それはお辛いですね。
dialogue.content: I see. That must be very painful for you.

dialogue.origin: お父様を亡くされたのは悲しみが深いでよね
dialogue.content: Losing your father must be a profound sorrow.

dialogue.origin: はい、まだ信じられないというか
dialogue.content: Yes, it's like I still can't believe it.

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: 調子が悪いと聞いていたので仕事も辞めて、介護に向かうつもりでした
dialogue.content: I had heard he wasn't doing well, so I had quit my job and was planning to go and care for him.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: でも、コロナで田舎の親戚が来なくていいと。
dialogue.content: But because of COVID, my relatives back home told me not to come.

dialogue.origin: なるほど
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: まさか、こんなに早くとも思っていなかったし
dialogue.content: I just never thought it would happen so soon.

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: 大切なお父様にお別れができなかったのはとても悲しいですよね
dialogue.content: It must be so sad not being able to say goodbye to your dear father.

dialogue.origin: 最期の死に目に会えなかったのは、それはそれでずいぶん長いこと離れて暮らしていたのでまだそれはどこかで仕方ないかなとは思うんですけど
dialogue.content: As for not being there at the very end when he passed, we had been living apart for a very long time, so on some level I feel like I can accept that...

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: 全国的に非常事態宣言もあったりした最中だったので反対されてそこも、仕方ないとは思います。
dialogue.content: And since it was during the nationwide state of emergency, they were against me coming, and I understand that was unavoidable as well.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: それで、行けばいいんでしょうけれど、いきなりお墓参りなのかなって思うと、、
dialogue.content: So, I know I should probably just go, but when I think about my first visit being straight to his grave...

dialogue.origin: どうも、予定を立てられなくて
dialogue.content: ...I just can't seem to make any plans.

dialogue.origin: 早く会いに行ってあげたい気もするんですけどね
dialogue.content: Though a part of me does want to go and see him soon.

dialogue.origin: そうでなんですね。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 気持ちの整理がなかなかつかないですよね
dialogue.content: It's difficult to sort through your feelings, isn't it?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: お父様を亡くされた哀しみと、お葬式に行けなかったことへの納得のいかないというお気持ちでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Is it a mix of grief over losing your father and unresolved feelings about not being able to attend the funeral?

dialogue.origin: どうなんでしょう？なんだか、怖いんです何でか分かりませんが
dialogue.content: I'm not sure... For some reason, I'm scared. I don't know why.

dialogue.origin: そうですか。怖いお気持ちもあるんですね。
dialogue.content: I see. So there's a feeling of fear as well.

dialogue.origin: お葬式は、形式的なものだし行けなかったことは仕方ないと頭では納得してます。
dialogue.content: In my mind, I understand that funerals are a formality and that it couldn't be helped that I wasn't able to go.

dialogue.origin: そのせいで親戚と余計な揉め事も起こしたくないし
dialogue.content: And I don't want to cause any unnecessary trouble with my relatives over it.

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: 父が亡くなったと認めたくないのかもしれないです。
dialogue.content: Maybe I just don't want to accept that my father has passed away.

dialogue.origin: なるほど。怖さというのは、現実を認める怖さなんでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I see. Could this fear be the fear of accepting reality?

dialogue.origin: なんていうか、父の居ない家が、もう、4ヶ月になるんですよね…変わってしまっているのかな、とか
dialogue.content: How should I put it... It's been four months now... I wonder if the house, without my father there, has changed.

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: 母が泣くのも目に見えるようだし、
dialogue.content: And I can just picture my mother crying.

dialogue.origin: 泣けば楽になりますかね電話で毎回泣かれるのでもう、しんどいんですよね
dialogue.content: I wonder if crying would make it easier... She cries every time we talk on the phone, and honestly, it's exhausting.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。本当にお辛いお気持ちだと思います。
dialogue.content: I see. I imagine that must be truly painful for you.

dialogue.origin: お母様も寂しくしていらっしゃるんですものね
dialogue.content: Your mother must be very lonely, too.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね母のためにも、行ってあげなくてはと頭では分かっているんですけどね
dialogue.content: That’s true. I know, in my head, that I should go for my mother’s sake, too.

dialogue.origin: かといって、コロナもすっかり無くなったわけでもないから周りからはそんなに歓迎されないような気もするし…
dialogue.content: But at the same time, COVID hasn’t completely gone away, so I feel like people there might not welcome me coming...

dialogue.origin: ええ。そうですよね。今の状況ではすぐに行くことは難しいですよね。
dialogue.content: Yes, you're right. It is difficult to go right away under the current circumstances.

dialogue.origin: お話の途中なんですが、ニックネームでもいいので、なんとお呼びすればよろしいですか？
dialogue.content: Pardon me for interrupting, but may I ask how I should address you? A nickname is fine.

dialogue.origin: はい…でも、親が死んでこんなに長い間何もしないでいるのって、親不孝かな、とか
dialogue.content: Yes... but, I wonder if I'm being a bad daughter, doing nothing for so long after my parent has died.

dialogue.origin: はいミユキです
dialogue.content: Yes, my name is Miyuki.

dialogue.origin: ミユキさん、ありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Thank you, Miyuki.

dialogue.origin: ずっとお辛い気持ちをがまんしていらっしゃったんですね
dialogue.content: You’ve been holding in these painful feelings for a long time.

dialogue.origin: はい悶々としてます
dialogue.content: Yes, I've been agonizing over it.

dialogue.origin: お父様を亡くされた悲しみ、帰ることのできないもどかしさ、お母様の辛さを受け止める切なさ・・・
dialogue.content: The grief of losing your father, the frustration of not being able to go back, the ache of taking in your mother’s pain...

dialogue.origin: 本当に苦しいお気持ちだと思います
dialogue.content: I can only imagine how agonizing this must be for you.

dialogue.origin: きちんと泣いていますか？
dialogue.content: Have you been able to properly cry?

dialogue.origin: はいこちらで夫の両親の介護もあるので、よほど気合を入れて周りの手配もしないといけないので
dialogue.content: Well, I’m also caring for my husband’s parents here, so I'd have to make a huge effort and arrange things with everyone around me.

dialogue.origin: それは、無いです
dialogue.content: No, I haven’t.

dialogue.origin: 泣かずに頑張っていらっしゃるんですか？
dialogue.content: So you've been trying to stay strong without crying?

dialogue.origin: たぶん実感がなかったせいだと思いますでも今聴いていただいてかなりうるうるしてます
dialogue.content: I think it's probably because it didn't feel real. But talking to you about it now, I can feel my eyes welling up.

dialogue.origin: 泣かずに我慢している理由はなんなのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Is there a reason you've been holding back your tears?

dialogue.origin: できるだけ考えないようにしてて。どうせコロナが収まらないと行けないしと
dialogue.content: I’ve been trying not to think about it as much as possible—telling myself I can’t go until COVID settles down anyway.

dialogue.origin: 同居の義父母も気遣ってくれてて、お義父さんはもうあんまり分からないんですけどお義母さんの手前、しょんぼりしてると心配させてしまうのもあるかもしれないです
dialogue.content: My in-laws, who live with us, have been very considerate. My father-in-law isn't very lucid anymore, but I feel that if I look sad in front of my mother-in-law, it will just make her worry.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか・・・色々なところにお気遣いされているんですね。
dialogue.content: I see... You're being so considerate of everyone around you.

dialogue.origin: はい…夫もうつだったので暗い話題は極力しないようにしています。
dialogue.content: Yes... My husband has also dealt with depression, so I try my best to avoid somber topics.

dialogue.origin: なるほど。そのように思っていらっしゃるんですね。
dialogue.content: I understand—that’s how you’ve been thinking about it.

dialogue.origin: 本当にお辛いですね。ずっと耐えていらしたミユキさん。今、ご自身のお気持ちはどのように捉えていらっしゃいますか？
dialogue.content: That is so much to bear. Miyuki, you've been enduring all this time. How do you see your own feelings right now?

dialogue.origin: 実家に帰ることについてですよね。
dialogue.content: You mean about going back to my parents’ home, right?

dialogue.origin: 夫とか身近な人に相談できないのが1番辛いです
dialogue.content: The hardest part is not being able to talk to my husband or anyone close to me about it.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。それはとてもお辛いですね。
dialogue.content: I see. That must be incredibly difficult.

dialogue.origin: はい…。
dialogue.content: Yes...

dialogue.origin: 今日、こちらにお話しにきてくださってありがとうございました。今までのお話を少し整理させていただいてもおろしいですか？
dialogue.content: Thank you for coming in to talk today. Would it be alright if I take a moment to summarize what you've told me?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: ５月にお父様がなくなったけれども、コロナ禍の中で、田舎のご親戚からも帰ってくるなと言われお葬式にも出れなかった。病気になったお父様を介護しようということも考えていた矢先だった・・
dialogue.content: Your father passed away in May, but amid the COVID pandemic, your relatives back home told you not to come, so you were unable to attend the funeral. This was right when you had been thinking about going to care for him after he became ill.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: お墓まいりにも行きたいが、親戚ともめるのも避けたいし・・でも、お母様は電話でいつも泣かれてしまってそれを受け止めるのも辛い・・・
dialogue.content: You want to visit his grave, but you also want to avoid conflict with your relatives. At the same time, your mother cries every time you speak on the phone, and it's painful for you to absorb her sadness.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 義父母の介護もあり、なかなかすぐに田舎には帰れないし、ご主人が鬱を患ったので、家で暗い話はしたくない・・
dialogue.content: You are also caring for your in-laws, which makes it difficult to return to your hometown right away, and because your husband has dealt with depression, you try to avoid somber topics at home.

dialogue.origin: そうですね
dialogue.content: That’s right.

dialogue.origin: 身近に相談できる人がいなくて、ご自分の辛いお気持ちを話せなくてつらいおもいをしていらっしゃる・・
dialogue.content: You feel you don't have anyone close by to confide in, and you're suffering because you can't speak about your painful feelings.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: いかかでしょうか？
dialogue.content: How does that sound?

dialogue.origin: そうです
dialogue.content: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: ここまでのお話で、私が思うことをお伝えしてもよろしいですか？
dialogue.content: Based on what you've shared, may I offer a thought?

dialogue.origin: はいお願いします
dialogue.content: Yes, please.

dialogue.origin: ミユキさんはこの世で一人のお父様を亡くされました。それは、一生に一度の悲しい出来事です。今まで、その悲しみを誰にも打ち明けずに我慢していらっしゃったのは、ミユキさんの周りへの優しさ、心遣い、我慢強さなのではないかと思います・・でも・・・
dialogue.content: Miyuki, you have lost your one and only father. This is a profound, once-in-a-lifetime loss. I believe the reason you have held this grief inside without sharing it with anyone is because of your kindness, your consideration for others, and your own strength. But...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes...

dialogue.origin: その悲しさをご自分できちんと受け入れてあげてもいいのではないでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Perhaps it’s okay to truly allow yourself to accept that sadness.

dialogue.origin: 受け入れる、、、
dialogue.content: Accept it...

dialogue.origin: ミユキさんの今の状況で、悲しいということ、悲しいと泣くことは誰からも責められることではないと思います
dialogue.content: In your situation, Miyuki, I don't think anyone would blame you for feeling sad or for crying because of that sadness.

dialogue.origin: はい、そうですかね。。
dialogue.content: Yes, do you think so...?

dialogue.origin: 母と一緒に泣けたらいいんでしょうね。。。
dialogue.content: It would be nice if I could cry together with my mother...

dialogue.origin: そうですよね・・・それができれば、本当にいいですよね
dialogue.content: Yes... if that were possible, that would be wonderful, wouldn't it.

dialogue.origin: でも、今の状況ではなかなか難しいですね・・直接会うのは難しくても、電話で気持ちを打ち明け、ミユキさんも泣くことはできませんか？
dialogue.content: But that's very difficult in the current situation... Even if meeting in person is hard, would it be possible to share your feelings over the phone and allow yourself to cry then, Miyuki?

dialogue.origin: はいお気遣い頂いて本当にありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Yes... thank you so much for your concern.

dialogue.origin: 悲しいお気持ちをがまんしないでください
dialogue.content: Please don't hold in your sadness.

dialogue.origin: そうですね母と話すときは母も親戚の手前、まだ来るな、みたいな事を言って結局終わるので
dialogue.content: You're right... When I talk to my mother, she's also mindful of the other relatives and ends up saying things like 'Don't come just yet,' and that's how the conversation always ends.

dialogue.origin: 何か父の事を思って手紙でも書いてみます。お別れの言葉とか、書いたら少し実感がわくかもしれませんよね。
dialogue.content: Maybe I'll try writing a letter to my father. If I write down my final words to him, perhaps it will start to feel more real.

dialogue.origin: そうですね。そういう方法もありますね。
dialogue.content: Yes, that's a wonderful idea.

dialogue.origin: 今までで、もう少しお話しになりたいことなどありますか？
dialogue.content: Is there anything else you would like to talk about for now?

dialogue.origin: コロナのことがあって行けるかどうかが、まずあったので今日聴いていただいて自分が悲しいんだって気がついたというか
dialogue.content: Because of COVID, the main issue was always whether I could even go or not. But talking with you today, I think I've realized for the first time just how sad I truly am.

dialogue.origin: 泣けるような気がします！
dialogue.content: I feel like I might be able to cry now!

dialogue.origin: 夫の事もあるといえばあるのですが、また今度お願いします。今日はありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: There is still the issue with my husband, but perhaps we can talk about that another time. Thank you so much for today.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか。今のコロナの世の中は、今までの状況と全く変わってしまって、本来ならばすぐにでもお父様に会いに行けたのに、それができないことで、ご自分の中でうまくお気持ちが整理できなかったのかもしれませんね・・
dialogue.content: I see. With the world being so different because of COVID, you weren't able to go see your father right away as you normally would have. Perhaps that inability to act is what made it so difficult to process your feelings.

dialogue.origin: そうですね、でも少しスッキリしました。
dialogue.content: Yes, that's true. But I do feel a little bit of relief now.

dialogue.origin: よかったです。今日はご主人のことまで深くはお話できませんでしたが、また、ぜひお話しに来てください。ミユキさんのお気持ちが少しでも楽になることを心から願っております
dialogue.content: I'm glad to hear that. We couldn't talk in depth about your husband today, but please feel free to come back anytime. I sincerely hope that you'll feel some relief.

dialogue.origin: はいありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Yes, thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: 今日はお話しに来てくださってありがとうございました。これで、終了となりますが、よろしいですか？
dialogue.content: Thank you for coming in to talk today. This will conclude our session, if that's alright with you.

dialogue.origin: はい。ありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Yes. Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: （お時間過ぎてしまってすみませんでした。今日はありがとうございました）
dialogue.content: (I’m sorry we ran over time. Thank you for today.)

dialogue.origin: (とんでもないです。ありがとうございました！)
dialogue.content: (Not at all. Thank you!)

dialogue.origin: （終了ボタン押させていただきます）
dialogue.content: (I’ll press the end button now.)

dialogue.origin: (はい、お願いします)
dialogue.content: (Okay, please do.)

topic.sub: 父の死による感情の整理と母との関係
